+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(states))
+	result := make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState, 0, len(states))
+	for _, fs := range states {
+		if _, exists := seen[fs.Key]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[fs.Key] = struct{}{}
+		result = append(result, fs)
+	}
+	return result
+}

+func unionFilterState(p1, p2 []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState) []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState {
+	combined := make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState, 0, len(p1)+len(p2))
+	combined = append(combined, p1...)
+	combined = append(combined, p2...)
+	return deduplicateFilterState(combined)

+func parseTTL(s string) (time.Duration, error) {
+	s = strings.TrimSpace(s)
+	if s == "" {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("empty ttl")
+	}
+	if secs, err := strconv.ParseInt(s, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if secs < 0 {
+			return 0, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl must be non-negative: %d", secs)
+		}
+		return time.Duration(secs) * time.Second, nil
+	}
+	d, err := time.ParseDuration(s)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: must be a Go duration string or integer seconds: %w", s, err)
+	}
+	if d < 0 {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl must be non-negative: %v", d)
+	}
+	return d, nil
+}

+func buildHashPolicies(ir *consistentHashIR) []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	if ir == nil || ir.disable {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	hasSubFields := len(ir.headers) > 0 ||
+		len(ir.cookies) > 0 ||
+		len(ir.queryParameters) > 0 ||
+		len(ir.filterState) > 0 ||
+		ir.sourceIP != nil
+
+	if !hasSubFields {
+		return []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+					ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+						SourceIp: true,
+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: false,
+			},
+		}
+	}
+
+	var policies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	// 1. headers
+	for _, h := range ir.headers {
+		headerPolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+			HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			headerPolicy.RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+				Header: headerPolicy,
+			},
+			Terminal: h.Terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 2. cookies
+	for _, c := range ir.cookies {
+		cookiePolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+			Name: c.Name,
+		}
+		if c.TTL != "" {
+			if dur, err := parseTTL(c.TTL); err == nil {
+				cookiePolicy.Ttl = durationpb.New(dur)
+			}
+		}
+		if c.Path != "" {
+			cookiePolicy.Path = c.Path
+		}
+		if len(c.Attributes) > 0 {
+			attrs := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, len(c.Attributes))
+			for i, attr := range c.Attributes {
+				attrs[i] = &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+					Name:  attr.Name,
+					Value: attr.Value,
+				}
+			}
+			cookiePolicy.Attributes = attrs
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+				Cookie: cookiePolicy,
+			},
+			Terminal: c.Terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 3. queryParameters
+	for _, q := range ir.queryParameters {
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: q.Name,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: q.Terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 4. filterState
+	for _, fs := range ir.filterState {
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: fs.Key,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: fs.Terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 5. sourceIp
+	if ir.sourceIP != nil {
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ir.sourceIP.Terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	return policies
+}
+
+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+
+	if ch.Disable {
+		if len(ch.Headers) > 0 || len(ch.Cookies) > 0 || len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 || len(ch.FilterState) > 0 || ch.SourceIP != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("when disable is true, no other fields may be set")
+		}
+		out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+			disable: true,
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	for _, h := range ch.Headers {
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.RegexRewrite.Pattern); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern %q for header %q: %w", h.RegexRewrite.Pattern, h.HeaderName, err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	for _, c := range ch.Cookies {
+		if c.TTL != "" {
+			if _, err := parseTTL(c.TTL); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	ir := &consistentHashIR{
+		disable:         false,
+		headers:         deduplicateHeaders(ch.Headers),
+		cookies:         deduplicateCookies(ch.Cookies),
+		queryParameters: deduplicateQueryParameters(ch.QueryParameters),
+		filterState:     deduplicateFilterState(ch.FilterState),
+	}
+	if ch.SourceIP != nil {
+		ir.sourceIP = &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{
+			Terminal: ch.SourceIP.Terminal,
+		}
+	}
+	ir.hashPolicies = buildHashPolicies(ir)
+
+	out.consistentHash = ir
+	return nil
+}
+
+func applyConsistentHash(ch *consistentHashIR, out *envoyroutev3.Route) {
+	if ch == nil || out == nil || out.GetRoute() == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	action := out.GetRoute()
+	if ch.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+	if len(ch.hashPolicies) > 0 {
+		action.HashPolicy = append([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy(nil), ch.hashPolicies...)
+	}
+}
